title: Stable Improvement Cycle Mechanism Versus Efficiency-adjusted Deferred Acceptance Mechanism beyond Weak Priority Orders
abstract: arXiv:2609.12543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper compares the stable improvement cycles (SIC) mechanism of Erdil and Ergin (2008) with the efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance (EADA) mechanism of Kesten (2010) in school choice problems with incomplete priorities. When school priorities are strict partial orders, we show that the EADA mechanism produces a constrained efficient matching. Combined with earlier results for the SIC mechanism, this establishes the outcome equivalence of the two mechanisms: the sets of matchings attainable under them coincide. We then move beyond transitivity and consider acyclic priority relations. On this broader domain, neither mechanism is guaranteed to produce a constrained efficient matching, but their failures take opposite forms. The SIC mechanism may under-improve: its outcome is always stable but may be Pareto dominated by another stable matching. translated_title: 超越弱优先序：稳定改进循环机制与效率调整延迟接受机制的比较
translated_abstract: 本文比较了Erdil和Ergin（2008）提出的稳定改进循环（SIC）机制与Kesten（2010）提出的效率调整延迟接受（EADA）机制在不完全优先序择校问题中的表现。当学校优先序为严格偏序时，我们证明EADA机制会产生受约束有效匹配。结合SIC机制的既有结果，这确立了两者的结果等价性：两种机制可实现的匹配集合完全一致。随后，我们超越传递性的限制，考虑无环优先关系。在这一更广泛的定义域上，两种机制都无法保证产生受约束有效匹配，但它们的失效形式截然相反。SIC机制可能出现“改进不足”：其结果总是稳定的，但可能被另一个稳定匹配帕累托占优。相比之下，EADA机制可能出现“过度改进”：其结果从不会被另一个稳定匹配帕累托占优……
tldr: 本文证明在严格偏序优先下SIC机制与EADA机制结果等价，并在无环优先关系下揭示两者以相反方式偏离受约束有效性——SIC可能改进不足，而EADA可能过度改进。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the outcome equivalence of the SIC and EADA mechanisms under strict partial order priorities, and reveals that under acyclic priorities they fail in opposite ways—the SIC may under-improve while the EADA may over-improve.
